Danny Boyle's new film 'Ink' explores AI's impact on journalism

Director Danny Boyle's upcoming film, titled 'Ink', will explore the evolving landscape of journalism, particularly focusing on the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI). The movie is set against the backdrop of the birth of a British tabloid newspaper. Boyle's work aims to chart the gritty beginnings of a publication, highlighting contemporary issues within the media industry.
